items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: That's where my wife and Lottie Grady was starred.

ctx.x: It's ordinary. What was Tony like when you first met him? Was he a good pianist or did he sing most of the time?

He was a very good pianist, yeah. He always was good. We had some good ones here then. Oscar Holden, Tony Jackson, Clarence Jones, Ed Harden. Ed played at the Peekin Theater, 2700 State. That's where my wife and Lottie Grady was starred. Nettie Lewis and Lottie Grady. Your wife's name was Lewis? Nettie Lewis then. She wasn't my wife then. No. No. And Lottie Grady now she's got a tavern in Idlewild, Michigan.
Was the Peekin Theater then? Yes. Did they have the theater?
